reviews.shade: K-SECRET Advanced Regenerating Eye Gel Patch (Retinol) 60 Patches
reviews.text: Product is very good comes with a lot of product on the patches feels very hydrating and my skin looks plumper instantly!
reviews.zh: 產品好好用，貼片上有好多精華，感覺非常保濕，皮膚即時望落更飽滿！

reviews.shade: K-SECRET Advanced Regenerating Eye Gel Patch (Retinol) 60 Patches
reviews.text: I didn’t realise the shape before I bought them, however I started using them in problem areas in my face and I think they are actually really good and something relaxing to have on.
reviews.zh: 買之前冇留意個形狀，不過我開始貼喺面上有問題嘅位置，覺得真係好好用，而且敷住好放鬆。

reviews.shade: K-SECRET Advanced Regenerating Eye Gel Patch (Retinol) 60 Patches
reviews.text: Пока не тестировала, но читала отзывы что хорошо работает под глазами, зимой начну пользоваться
reviews.zh: 仲未試過，但睇過評論話對眼周效果好，冬天先開始用。

reviews.shade: K-SECRET Advanced Regenerating Eye Gel Patch (Retinol) 60 Patches
reviews.text: They feel great and I love the little scooper that comes with it to pick them up. I do wish there was more serum in the patches
reviews.zh: 用落感覺好好，而且好鍾意跟埋嚟嘅細細個匙羹，可以幫手撩起。希望貼片上嘅精華再多啲就好。

reviews.shade: K-SECRET Advanced Regenerating Eye Gel Patch (Retinol) 60 Patches
reviews.text: Honestly haven't noticed any difference in my skin yet! Used for few weeks 3-4 times a week. But it peels soo much after removing it
reviews.zh: 講真到而家都未見到皮膚有咩分別！用咗幾個禮拜，一個禮拜 3-4 次。但係撕走之後甩皮甩得好嚴重。

reviews.shade: K-SECRET Advanced Regenerating Eye Gel Patch (Retinol) 60 Patches
reviews.text: I’m not sure if this product is making a difference with my skin, but I do love the refreshing feeling it provides and how it helps me relax.
reviews.zh: 唔知呢個產品對我塊面有冇幫助，但係真係鍾意佢嗰種清新嘅感覺，同埋可以幫我放鬆。

reviews.shade: K-SECRET Advanced Regenerating Eye Gel Patch (Retinol) 60 Patches
reviews.text: Feels super good ,super refreshing, has a beautiful pink glow, I would need to wait for more uses to check if it improves my skin eye area but so far I like them very much, so as my mom
reviews.zh: 用落好好，清新舒服，帶有靚嘅粉紅光澤，要再用多幾次先知可唔可以改善眼周皮膚，但係到而家我同媽媽都好鍾意。

reviews.shade: K-SECRET Advanced Regenerating Eye Gel Patch (Retinol) 60 Patches
reviews.text: I used a jar and then bought another one but I noticed something happening when I used the second jar. After I use the patches, tap in the extra product and apply my other skin care this pilling happens. little goop balls that freaked me out. Is it the product or did I not exfoliate but I noticed this happened even after my skin was properly prepped. I feel like I wasted my money.
reviews.zh: 我用完一罐之後再買多一罐，但用第二罐嗰陣發現有啲問題。用完眼貼、輕拍剩餘嘅精華再搽其他護膚品之後，搓泥情況就會出現。一粒粒細細粒嘅膠粒，睇到我心都寒。唔知係產品問題定係我冇去角質，但即使皮膚有好好做準備，呢個情況都會出現。我覺得我嘅錢白使咗。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
